commits.subject: fix(deploy): reset to origin/deploy instead of pull origin/main
commits.body:
Previously: workflow ran git pull --ff-only on bts-mlb's main branch,
which pulled origin/main. But `git push origin main:deploy` only
advances origin/deploy — leaving origin/main behind. Result was silent
no-op deploys: workflow succeeded, scheduler restarted, canary passed,
but no new code applied.

Observed today (2026-04-28 11:06 ET): pushed main:deploy with 6 new
commits, workflow reported success in 45s, but bts-mlb's HEAD remained
at the pre-push SHA. Verified by inspecting git log on bts-mlb after
deploy "succeeded".

Now: workflow does `git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/deploy`,
guaranteeing the working tree matches whatever was just pushed to deploy.
Single push (`git push origin main:deploy`) is now sufficient — no need
to also push main.

Hard reset is safe on bts-mlb since no local commits are expected on a
prod box. Rollback path (line ~85) already uses `git reset --hard`, so
this aligns the forward path with the rollback path.
